verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              निदाघान्तकरः कालः सर्वभूतसुखावहः। तत्रैव वसतां तेषां प्रावृट् समभिपद्यत॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said: While they (the Pandavas) were living there, the rainy season, which puts an end to summer and is agreeable to all creatures, made its appearance.

verses.sanskrit: छादयन्तो महाघोषाः खं दिशश्च बलाहकाः। प्रववर्षुर्दिवारात्रमसिताः सततं तदा॥२॥
verses.english: Then, hundreds and thousands of sable clouds covering the entire) firmament and the cardinal points, emitting thundering roars and looking like (so many) awnings in the rainy season, incessantly poured down showers night and day. The effulgence of the sun disappeared from the earth; and its place was filled by the stainless splendour of lightning.
verses.bhavadeepa: उक्तामेव ब्रह्मविद्यां मार्कण्डेयमुखेन नानाऽऽख्यानपूर्वकं प्रपञ्चयिष्यन् तदुपोद्घातत्वेन काम्यकप्रवेशं तावदाह निदाघान्तकरः काल इत्यादिना ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: विरूढशष्पा धरणी मत्तदंशसरीसृपा। बभूव पयसा सिक्ता शान्ता सर्वमनोरमा॥४॥
verses.english: And the earth, over grown with grass teeming with gnats and reptiles, maddened with joy and saturated with water, looked serene and became delightful to all.
verses.bhavadeepa: तपात्यये वर्षासु निकेता इव मण्डपीभूता इत्यर्थः ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: न स्म प्रज्ञायते किञ्चिदम्भसा समवस्तृते। समं वा विषमं वाऽपि नद्यो वा स्थावराणि च॥५॥
verses.english: When the (surface of the earth was flooded with water it could not be discerned whether the ground was even or uneven or whether there were rivers, ground.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुब्धतोया महावेगाः श्वसमाना इवाशुगाः। सिन्धवः शोभयाञ्चक्रुः काननानि तपात्यये॥६॥
verses.english: At the close of summer, the streams full of agitated waters and careering violently with a hissing noise like (flight of) arrows, lent a grace to the woods.

verses.sanskrit: नदतां काननान्तेषु श्रूयन्ते विविधाः स्वनाः। वृष्टिभिश्च्छाद्यमानानां वराहमृगपक्षिणाम्॥७॥
verses.english: The boars, the stage and the birds, drenched in water began to utter various sounds that could be heard in the forests.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोककाः शिखिनश्चैव पुंस्कोकिलगणैः सह। मत्ताः परिपतन्ति स्म दर्दुराश्चैव दर्पिताः॥८॥
verses.english: The Chatakas, .the peacocks, the male kokilas and the excited frogs all intoxicated (with joy) began to frolic about.

verses.sanskrit: तथा बहुविधाकारा प्रावृण्मेघानुनादिता। अभ्यतीता शिवा तेषां चरतां मरुधन्वसु॥९॥
verses.english: Thus, while the Pandavas were wandering about in dry sandy tracts at the neighbourhood of mountains the delightful rainy season so various in aspect and resounding with (the roar of) the clouds passed away.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्तोका एव स्तोककाश्चातकाः ।‘स्तोकस्त्रिष्वल्पे चातके पुमान्’ इति मेदिनी । दर्दुरा मण्डूकाः॥८॥

verses.english: Then came autumn, crowded with ganders and cranes, when the forest tracts were over grown with verdure and the streams became clear.

verses.sanskrit: विमलाकाशनक्षत्रा शरत्तेषां शिवाऽभवत्। मृगद्विजसमाकीर्णा पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥११॥
verses.english: The sky and the stars shone with a stainless lustre and the country was swarmed with beasts and birds. This season of autumn became auspicious to the high-souled sons of Pandu.
verses.bhavadeepa: रूढकक्षाणि बहुतृणानि वनानि प्रस्थशब्दोदितानि सानूनि च यस्यां सा तथा । ‘प्रस्थो स्त्रियां मानभेदे सानावत्युच्चवस्तुनि’ इति मेदिनी ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते शान्तरजसः क्षपा जलदशतिलाः। ग्रहनक्षत्रसङ्घैश्च सोमेन च विराजिताः॥१२॥
verses.english: (Then) the nights free from dust and cool with clouds were adorned with numerous stars, planets and the moon.

verses.sanskrit: कुमुदैः पुण्डरीकैश्च शीतवारिधराः शिवाः। नदीः पुष्करिणीश्चैव ददृशुः समलङ्कृताः॥१३॥
verses.english: And (the Pandavas) beheld the rivers and the tanks, full of cool water and beautified with lilies and lotuses and pleasant (to the eye)

verses.sanskrit: आकाशनीकाशतटां तीरवानीरसङ्कुलाम्। बभूव चरतां हर्षः पुण्यतीर्थां सरस्वतीम्॥१४॥
verses.english: And they experienced a great delight in wandering along the sacred Sarasvati whose banks resemble the firmament and are covered with canes.

verses.sanskrit: ते वै मुमुदिरे वीराः प्रसन्नसलिलां शिवाम्। पश्यन्तो दृढधन्वानः परिपूर्णां सरस्वतीम्॥१५॥
verses.english: And those wielders of strong bows were highly glad at seeing the auspicious Sarasvati full of limpid water.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पुण्यतमा रात्रिः पर्वसन्धौ स्म शारदी। तत्रैव वसतामासीत् कार्तिकी जनमेजय॥१६॥
verses.english: O Janamejaya, while dwelling there they passed the most sacred night of the full moon in the month of Kartika.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यकृद्भिर्महासत्त्वैस्तापसैः सह पाण्डवाः। तत् सर्वे भरतश्रेष्ठाः समूहुर्योगमुत्तमम्॥१७॥
verses.english: And in company with the righteous and high-souled ascetics, the Pandavas, the best of the Bharatas, spent that juncture in excellent devotion.

verses.sanskrit: तमिस्त्राभ्युदये तस्मिन् धौभ्येन सह पाण्डवाः। सूतैः पौरोगवैश्चैव काम्यकं प्रययुर्वनम्॥१८॥
verses.english: And when the dark fort-night set in immediately after, the sons of Pandu together with Dharma and their charioteers and cooks proceeded to the forest of Kamyaka.
verses.bhavadeepa: योगं युज्यते रथादाविति व्युत्पत्त्या वाहनादिकं समूहुरारोपितभारं कृतवन्तः ॥१७॥
